key.name: autosave-interval-seconds
key.description: Seconds between periodic Kitty session snapshots.

key.name: kitty-command
key.description: An executable name on PATH or an absolute path to Kitty.

key.name: resume-foreground-processes
key.description: Save foreground commands so Kitty can restart commands included in the auto-run allowlist.

key.name: auto-run-commands
key.description: Executable names or absolute paths that may be restarted from a saved Kitty session.

key.name: kitten-command
key.description: An executable name on PATH or an absolute path to Kitten.

key.name: socket-template
key.description: The Kitty remote-control address. The {pid} placeholder is required; {runtimeDir} and {uid} are also supported.

key.name: kitty-window-identifiers
key.description: Application IDs or WM_CLASS values that identify Kitty windows.
